none: PAS CAM-1A972B: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, AD 367-383
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian (AD 367-383), dating to AD 367-75 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLOR[IA NOVI SAECVLI]. Reverse shows Gratian standing, holding standard and shield. Mint of Arles. RIC IX, no. 15. Reverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows an unclear, diademed or laureate, draped and cuirassed bust right. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.55g, diameter is 17.8mm,…
